execution_trace.rationale: Created a shared Notion Adapter in modules/shared/notion-adapter.js which contains the single source of truth for NOTION_TOKEN reading from chrome.storage.local and provides a robust fetch function. Refactored the 'globo' and 'caza' modules to eliminate duplicate NOTION_TOKEN reads and generic fetch retries, hooking them to NotionAdapter. Updated module.json and registry.js to stop listing NOTION_TOKEN, as the shell no longer needs to configure it per-module since it's global.
